MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next step because it extends my recent Alexa setup and connects with my earlier interest in door alarms.",
    "The Blink bundle and Echo Dot with a clock fit my interest in connected home devices, although I would start with one doorbell and do not need another speaker today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick and older Echo Dot repeat functions covered by devices I recently bought, so their familiarity does not give me a reason to choose them now.",
    "The memory cards fit some older purchases, but I have no current storage task for them. The internal SSD also assumes an upgrade I am not planning, while my previous drive purchase was external.",
    "The AirPods do not connect to a current need; my recent interest has been in home devices and practical computer accessories."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Alexa devices seems to have been taken as a reason to offer more speakers and streaming devices, even when I already have newer versions.",
    "My past memory card, card reader, and hard drive purchases seem to have been treated as an ongoing need for storage, regardless of the task or device compatibility."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have already filled; a useful addition is more appealing than another version of something I just bought.",
    "Compatibility alone does not make me need an item. The doorbell offers a distinct use, but I would check installation requirements and try it before committing to several cameras."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and useful electronics, but too often confuse familiar products with something I need next."
}
